justification: Inspected javaparser-core-testing/src/test/resources/com/github/javaparser/storage/PrimaryType.java, PrimaryType2.java, and Z.java: all three are trivial test fixtures, and none contains any imports or references to other packages (PrimaryType is an empty class; PrimaryType2 and Z only declare the package). CompilationUnitTest.java only uses these files as parsed test resources, so the package has no observable outgoing package dependencies to less-stable packages; therefore UD is not present.
